flags.message: Same-day capital vacatur application: the execution was scheduled for 10:00 CDT on the filing date and the Court's disposition is expected within hours of the snapshot, so this forward cell's horizon is unusually short. I retrieved the Sixth Circuit order under review and its docket (no entry after the 09:17 stay order) but did not look up this application's own disposition and none surfaced.

The interim statpack anchor (pooled 31/296 = 10.5% over Terms 2024-2025) mixes every substantive applicant class; I adjusted to ~0.72 on a from-memory grant history for state applications to vacate stays of execution, which is not a committed cut. An applicant-class cut in the interim section would let this class anchor on a published figure.
